policy.statement: A claim is not treated as learned, trained, or validated unless its evidence and verification method are recorded.

records.claim: The v0.3.0 baseline renders one articulated arm chain in renderCharacter and has no screen-left arm group.
records.limitation: This is a source-architecture finding, not a measure of every possible rendered frame.

records.claim: Baseline hand-aim validation compares angles derived from the same wrist-to-target vector used to construct handAngle, so it does not independently validate the rendered pointing gesture.
records.limitation: This identifies a correlated metric design; visual review is still required.

records.claim: Scene schema and regression tests require both screen-left and screen-right arms/hands plus torso, head and legs render groups.
records.verification_method: GitHub Actions workflow 39170991263: scene schema validation, evidence ledger validation, browser HTTP smoke test, node regression tests, seven synthetic benchmarks, raster diagnostic, Python schema tests, FFmpeg render/FFprobe, source packaging and artifact upload.

evidence.symbol: bilateral rig exists in both data and rendered SVG

records.limitation: The CI proves that both arm chains exist in frame state and their required SVG groups render, and that both IK chains preserve segment lengths. It does not certify natural anatomy, artistic approval, collision-free silhouettes, or learned motion.

records.claim: No external motion/image dataset has been downloaded or ingested in this implementation stage.
records.limitation: No data-learning, training, fine-tuning, or improved model capability is claimed.

records.claim: No model training or fine-tuning has been performed as part of this code change.
records.limitation: The code remains a deterministic procedural 2D rig and motion model.

records.claim: The canonical 96-frame pilot checks the emitted SVG pointing-hand transform against deterministic pose state, including rendered aim, origin, fingertip and hand scale.
records.verification_method: GitHub Actions runs scripts/validate-rendered-pose.mjs on every declared frame; regression tests require a deliberately altered hand rotation and missing index-finger group to fail closed.

evidence.symbol: serialized SVG hand aim and transform mutation regressions

records.limitation: This verifies serialized geometry consistency, not natural motion, collision-free silhouettes, semantic correctness of arbitrary animation or artistic acceptance.
